paragraphs: Fieldman is an American software and services company that helps utility contractors and municipalities manage assets, jobs, work orders, and field projects. The platform is built for AMI projects, where spreadsheets and generic work order software break down. The site says contractors have run it on more than 200 AMI projects.

Assets and work orders load into a web portal where managers and dispatchers track, update, and search them. Project requirements become digital workflows built with branch logic, so technicians are guided step by step. Scheduling covers resident appointment booking, blackout dates, inventory, and assignment by technician availability. In the field, technicians capture photos, GPS locations, signatures, and meter readings. Collection keeps working even in areas without internet access.

Fieldman is family-owned, with no venture backing and no public trading. It started in 2019, when a founder set out to build management software for utility field service projects. The company says its founders personally set up the platform for a customer's field operations. Its published client stories come from utilities and contractors running field operations on the platform.
